title: Goodbye Love (HKLGFF 2026)
synopsis:
Morelia International Film Festival

Festival MIX México

 

Asian Premiere

 

After more than a decade living undocumented in the USA, Chuy is deported back to the small Sinaloa fishing village he once fled. But home has changed: drugs and the cartel now rule, violence is the texture of daily life, and Chano, his first love, has become a feared hitman. Thrown together again in this hostile landscape, their old romance reignites, forcing Chuy to choose between the man he never stopped loving and the future he longs to build. Writer-director Indra Villaseñor Amador's debut feature sets forbidden tenderness against the brutal machinery of the narco world, a love story whispered through the streets of a place that has no room for it. Nominated for Best Mexican Film at the 2025 Morelia International Film Festival, GOODBYE LOVE is an aching elegy for love under impossible conditions.
